patthana11.7:1.1: na kusalaṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.7:2.1: na kusalaṃ na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika nadassanenapahātabbahetukattikaṃ
patthana11.7:3.1: na kusalaṃ na dassanena pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.7:4.1: na kusalaṃ na nevadassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika naācayagāmittikaṃ
patthana11.7:5.1: na kusalaṃ na ācayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.7:6.1: na kusalaṃ na apacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.7:7.1: na kusalaṃ na nevācayagāmināpacayagāmiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika nasekkhattikaṃ
patthana11.7:8.1: na kusalaṃ na sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.7:9.1: na kusalaṃ na nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika naparittattikaṃ
patthana11.7:10.1: na kusalaṃ na parittaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ..
patthana11.7:11.1: na kusalaṃ na mahaggataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na appamāṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattikana parittārammaṇattikaṃ
patthana11.7:12.1: na kusalaṃ na parittārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na mahaggatārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca .. na kusalaṃ na appamāṇārammaṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca ... nakusalattika
